伟大之术相关机制标签，保留揭开帷幕意象。

source: You can pay in cash, or you can offer items for barter, if you have anything the merchant's interested in. But you'll often need to top up with cash - look at the total in the barter block.
translation: 你可以付现金；若有商人感兴趣的物品，也可以拿来易货。不过通常仍要补些现金——请查看易货栏中的总额。
notes: 交易教程说明，采用直接 UI 口吻。

source: A little white ceramic jar containing a small quantity of golden ink - uzult, one of the five encausta terminalia, the Great Inks in which interpretations of [[Histories]] can be recorded by the appointed few. [This is a precious substance. Use it only at need. You can sell it, but few in all Europe will appreciate its true price.]
translation: 一只白色小陶罐，盛着少量金色墨水——乌祖尔特，五种encausta terminalia之一。获准的少数人能以这些大墨记录对[[Histories]]的阐释。 [这是珍贵之物。不到非用不可，不要动它。你可以卖掉它，但全欧洲也没几个人识得它的真正价值。]
notes: Uzult／Great Inks 沿前批译“乌祖尔特／大墨”；保留拉丁斜体、链接、段落与方括号。
孤立状态显示名；若实际为礼物语境需界面复核。
状态说明。
与本批前文统一，保留纺线意象。

translation: 记忆：圣斯德望节前夕，巴黎，1907年
notes: 天主教圣名采用“斯德望”。
UI 分区标签。
状态标签。

source: A covenant of travel in silence. 'Twilight and evening bell / And after that the dark!'
translation: 一份静默旅行之约。‘暮色与晚钟／此后便是黑暗！’
notes: 引自丁尼生《过沙洲》；保留斜杠分行结构。
场景名。

source: The Mansus has fallen, but we still dream. Dr Aubière must go somewhere to dream. A sufficiently skilled nyctodromist might follow him there - or perhaps there's another way.
translation: 漫宿已经陷落，但我们仍会做梦。奥比耶医生必定也要去某处入梦。技艺足够高明的夜游术士或许能跟过去——也可能另有办法。
notes: Mansus 依术语表译“漫宿”；Aubière 按总表译“奥比耶”。

source: I gave Zèlia the letter from Maître Argant. She seems convinced it is, indeed, her missing husband. A happy ending.
translation: 我把阿尔冈律师的信交给了泽莉娅。她似乎确信，他的确就是自己失踪的丈夫。皆大欢喜。
notes: Maître 在法语人名语境为律师称谓；保留末句可能不可靠的轻快收束。
Rosa Mundi／calendrier 沿前批译名。
沿前批专名译法。

source: Tracks what the player last ordered, for inconspicuous callback
translation: 记录玩家上次点的东西，以便不着痕迹地呼应。
notes: 开发／变量说明，保留功能含义。

source: I agreed to find her husband... for the price of ten thousand francisques.
translation: 我答应替她寻找丈夫……代价是一万弗朗西斯克。
notes: francisque 作为货币单位沿前批音译。

source: Light - light leaks through the cracks...
notes: 保留 Light 的重复与未完省略。
疑为内部占位／文化梗，原样保留。
关系 UI 标签；人名沿前批。

translation: 斯宾塞怎么称呼美狄亚？
notes: 变量说明；Medea 沿既有独立专名译“美狄亚”。
UI 标签；保留分隔结构。

source: Zèlia wants to know if I'm the 'signaire' she tried to summon.
translation: 泽莉娅想知道，我是不是她试图召唤的那个‘signaire’。
notes: signaire 为尚未定译的设定词，沿前批保留原文。

source:
'Gentlemen perspire, ladies glow, horses sweat.' Ergo, I'm not sweating. But I'd be slightly more comfortable in something lighter.

[A lighter Outfit would provide a small bonus.]
translation:
‘绅士冒汗，淑女容光焕发，马才流汗。’所以，我没有流汗。不过换身轻薄些的衣服，我会稍微舒服一点。

[更轻薄的服装会提供少量加成。]
notes: 保留英语礼仪俗语的阶级笑话、段落和方括号教程。
状态／目标名。
状态标签。
Heart 依术语表译“心”。
物品名。

source: O wad some Pow'r the giftie gie us To see oursels as ithers see us! - Burns Done. You're welcome. Review the opinions of your Associates - characters of some importance in your life - at any time on this Journal page.
translation: 但愿上天赐我们本领 能像旁人一样看清自己！ ——彭斯 好了。不必客气。你可以随时在本日志页查看同伴对你的看法——他们是你生命中颇为重要的人物。
notes: 保留斜体与全部换行；诗句为彭斯《致虱子》名句，采用凝练意译；Associates／Journal 按 UI 译“同伴／日志”。

source: I haven't performed gentleman's rites this morning.
translation: 今早我还没有完成绅士的晨间仪式。
notes: 与同批肯定状态句统一。
保留三项递进。

source:
When the feast of the Sun's Resurrection came to Brancrug, the rectory was still cold - those old stone walls, thick as a castle's - and with no housekeeper, I had to lay my own fire... 

Recall <link="mypastanastasis">My Past: Anastasis, Brancrug, 1920</link>
translation:
太阳复活节来到布兰库格时，教区长宅仍旧寒冷——那些古老石墙厚得像城堡——而我又没有管家，只得亲自生火…… 

回忆<link="mypastanastasis">我的过往：复生，布兰库格，1920年</link>
notes: 沿 chunk_009／010 的既有整段与回忆标题译法；保留省略号后的空格、段落及 link 标签。
地名。

source: VSTUPNÍ VÍZUM. An official signature on an official stamp adorned by the two-tailed lion of Bohemia. Czechoslovakia is not yet, not quite, not quite yet, a People's Republic.
translation: VSTUPNÍ VÍZUM。正式签名落在正式印章上，印章饰以波希米亚双尾狮。捷克斯洛伐克尚不是——还不算、还没完全算——人民共和国。
notes: 捷克语签证标题原样保留；保留反复措辞及源文尾随空格。
性相标签。
疑为内部未拆分状态键；为避免破坏逻辑原样保留。
Limian 与本批“利米亚修会”词根统一。
报刊名沿 chunk_005。

source: To advance another Plan, I could use an item that has the [[Wither]] aspect. A Midnight Mark would be perfect.
translation: 要推进另一项计划，我可以使用一件具备[[Wither]]性相的物品。午夜之印再合适不过。
notes: 保留链接；Aspect 依术语表译“性相”；Midnight Mark 暂译“午夜之印”。
服装订单名，与同批包裹名统一。

source:
A pre-war passport in the name of Mr Spencer Hobson. My place of birth is given as Kerisham, in England.

It's a real passport, but the government's changed the law, and it might not be valid much longer.
translation:
一本战前签发、属于斯宾塞·霍布森先生的护照。出生地写的是英格兰凯里沙姆。

这是真护照，但政府已经修改法律，它恐怕很快就会失效。
notes: Kerisham 暂沿 chunk_005 译“凯里沙姆”；保留段落。

source: Zèlia was satisfied with her revenge on Philomèle, though she seemed a little confused about exactly whom she had been revenged upon. In any case, she paid me.
translation: 泽莉娅对自己向菲洛梅勒复仇的结果很满意，尽管她似乎有点弄不清自己究竟报复了谁。不管怎样，她付了钱。
notes: 保留复仇对象错乱的冷幽默。

source: This is too tiny an offer for the merchant to bother with. You need to put enough on the table for at least one note of the currency they're offering.
translation: 这份报价少得不值得商人费心。你放上桌面的价值，至少要抵得上一张对方所用货币的纸币。
notes: 易货教程说明。

source: Occult treasures are purchased with occult coin: spintriae. This one is silver. Its reverse displays a man and woman coupling. Their configuration implies enthusiasm, but what can be seen of their faces suggests boredom.
translation: 秘术珍宝要用秘术钱币购买：春宫币。这一枚是银制的。背面刻着一对交合的男女。姿势显得兴致勃勃，依稀可见的面孔却透着无聊。
notes: spintria 沿前批译“春宫币”；保留末句色情图像与倦怠表情的反差。

translation: 记忆：米迦勒节，布兰库格，1921年
notes: 沿 chunk_009 回忆标题译法。
保留方括号教程结构。
痛苦阶段状态标签。

source: I've determined that I'll wake at midnight.
translation: 我已打定主意，要在午夜醒来。
notes: 状态说明。

source: Double-click to run. If you click somewhere distant, Spencer will break into a run anyway, perhaps from sheer enthusiasm, perhaps out of desperation.
translation: 双击即可奔跑。地点点得够远，斯宾塞自己也会跑起来——或许是兴致使然，或许是走投无路。
notes: 操作教程保持直接，保留末句调侃。
物品名；Hint 可能为设定实体，暂保留“暗示”歧义。

source:
With time and travel, good things become bad things: sandwiches, soufflé, flower arrangements.

[All Perishable items will disappear when you travel.]
translation:
随着时间与旅行，好东西会变成坏东西：三明治、舒芙蕾、插花。

[旅行时，所有易腐物品都会消失。]
notes: Perishable 与本批性相标签统一译“易腐”；保留段落与方括号。
状态显示名。
Knock 依术语表译“启”；沿前批系统句式。
性相标签。
保留查询变量；Exhausted 统一译“精疲力竭”。

source: Set whenever we exit the map. Important for tracking how we got to a minor destination circus scene
translation: 每次退出地图时设置。用于追踪我们如何进入次要目的地的马戏团场景，十分重要。
notes: 开发变量说明。

source: Walled and wooded town aboil now with revolution
translation: 有墙有林的小镇，如今因革命而沸腾
notes: 目的地短描述；保留无句号结构。

source: Clouds part; wounds creak; doors strain.
translation: 云层分开；伤口作响；门扉绷紧。
notes: 保留三项物质化异象与分号节奏。

source: No dawn knows only a single colour. No sky knows only a single dawn.
translation: 没有哪个黎明只知一种颜色。没有哪片天空只知一个黎明。
notes: 保留重复、悖论与 knows 的拟人。
商店／UI 状态。

source: When you move the cursor over something interactable, it'll highlight. Or hold Z to highlight everything interactable on screen.
translation: 将光标移到可交互对象上时，对象会高亮。也可以按住Z键，高亮屏幕上的所有可交互对象。
notes: 保留按键名 Z；操作教程保持直接。

source: The proper use of this sombre sign silences restless spirits. Improper use can trouble the sleep and health of living human spirits.
translation: 正确使用这道阴郁之印，能使躁动的灵魂沉寂。使用不当，则会扰乱生者的睡眠与健康。
notes: 保留 spirits 在亡灵与生者精神之间的复义。
Lantern 依术语表译“灯”。

source:
The Knock permits no seal and no isolation. It is the [[Principle]] that thrusts us gleefully out of the safety of ignorance. 

The Hour that unsealed and unseamed is Uncounted now. Another Hour stood at every threshold: perhaps it persists.
translation:
启不容封缄，也不容隔绝。它是将我们欢欣地推出无知庇护的[[Principle]]。 

那位解封又拆缝的司辰，如今已失数。另一位司辰曾立于每一道门槛：或许仍然存在。
notes: Knock／Hour 依术语表译“启／司辰”；保留链接、段落、首段尾随空格及 Uncounted 的含混。 术语归位：Uncounted 谓语/定语形统一为"失数"（名词形"失数者"），不用释义性变体"不在数中"。
纺织系秘术物品复合词，暂译“夸口乱结”，待实物图与前作术语复核。
教程标题。

source: Dr Aubière declares he will tell me where to find Nina, if I stay a few days at the Sanitarium and attend sessions with him. Aubière, however, has already reneged on one arrangement. There are likely other possibilities at the Sanitarium to winkle the information out.
translation: 奥比耶医生声称，只要我在疗养院住上几天、接受几次诊疗，他就会告诉我去哪找妮娜。可奥比耶已经反悔过一次。疗养院里大概还有别的办法能套出情报。
notes: 状态／计划说明；保留主角对承诺可靠性的怀疑。
Karlshorst 为柏林地名；Fleck 疑为架空货币名，暂译“斑币”。

translation: 舒舒服服地躺在沙发上。
notes: 状态说明。

source: At [q=Pain] Pain, my Twinges have gone.
translation: 痛苦降至[q=Pain]点时，我的刺痛已经消失。
notes: 保留查询变量；Twinges 与同批状态标签统一。
目标／状态名。
保留英语惯用语的生死抉择意象。
Refreshments 沿其他游戏数据批次译“茶点”。
状态显示名。
与 Wither／Withering“凋萎”统一。

source: Traces [q=trace]. I'm no longer a subject of Rumour.
translation: 痕迹：[q=trace]。我已不再是流言的对象。
notes: 保留查询变量；Traces／Rumour 暂译“痕迹／流言”。

source: A web of subtle work to encourage peace, healing and a slow knitting-together of possibilities.
translation: 一张精工织就的网，让和平、疗愈与种种可能慢慢缝合。
notes: 保留 web／knitting 的连续纺织意象。
地点／状态显示名。

source: A pure white square of fine linen. Cambric; named for [[Cambray]] town…
translation: 一方纯白的细亚麻布。康布里克细布；因[[Cambray]]城得名……
notes: 保留链接与省略号；Cambric 采用织物通称音译。

source: Here is the road long concealed from their sight.
translation: 这便是那条长久隐于他们眼前的道路。
notes: 仪式／制作说明，保留揭示语气。
关系 UI 标签；人名沿前批。

source: The town in the forest is the forest in the town, now
translation: 林中之镇，如今成了镇中之林
notes: 保留交错反复与无句号的目的地短句。

source:
October in [[Brancrug]], the last year before the war. Dusk-purple heather, grey-growling sea...

Recall <link="mypaststreparataseve">My Past: St Reparata's Eve, Brancrug, 1938</link>
translation:
战前最后一年，[[Brancrug]]的十月。暮紫的石楠，灰沉低吼的海……

回忆<link="mypaststreparataseve">我的过往：圣雷帕拉塔节前夕，布兰库格，1938年</link>
notes: 保留链接、link 标签与段落；St Reparata 沿前批译“圣雷帕拉塔”。

source:
It's much too hot to be wearing this. Uncomfortable and embarrassing.

[Change to a lighter Outfit - or stay inside.]
translation:
天气太热，实在不该穿这身。既不舒服，又显得尴尬。

[换上更轻薄的服装——或者留在室内。]
notes: 服装机制说明；保留段落与方括号。
服装名与 chunk_005 统一。

source: Finishing a Plan gives a choice of [[Experiences]]. Collect them by clicking the Plan, which you'll find under the Finished column.
translation: 完成计划后，你可以从[[Experiences]]中任选一项。点击“已完成”栏中的计划即可领取。
notes: 保留链接及末尾双换行；教程 UI 保持直接。
架空货币名，沿前批。

source: I've learnt where to look for Nina Lagasse. I have no need to pester Dr A in his dreams.
translation: 我已经知道去哪里找妮娜·拉加斯。没必要再到梦里纠缠奥比耶医生。
notes: Nina Lagasse 依术语表；Dr A 按上下文展开。
教程标题。
变量标签。

source:
Refreshments are, generally, delicious. Use them to restore pips in your [[Aspect Pool]].
- Most Refreshments expire when [[travelling]] - eat up before you go
- You can only use Refreshments when they match missing pips - mouse over the Refreshment to check.
translation:
茶点通常很好吃，也能补回[[Aspect Pool]]中的点数。
- 多数茶点会在[[travelling]]时过期——上路前赶紧吃完
- 缺少的点数与茶点相符时才能使用——将鼠标悬停在茶点上即可查看。
notes: Refreshments 统一译“茶点”；保留两个链接、换行与列表连字符。

source: Jean-Bernard rather wistfully asked me to remember him to the  bookseller Andrée, who sells other things than books.
translation: 让-贝尔纳颇为惆怅地托我向书商安德蕾问好；她卖的并不只有书。
notes: 保留 quieter business 的含蓄暗示；源文 bookseller 前双空格未承载结构。
Stars 作为设定存在译“群星”。

source:
This is how it ends.

Current Pain: [q=pain]
translation:
事情就这样结束。

当前痛苦：[q=pain]
notes: 保留段落与查询变量；维持简短不祥语气。

source: 'The City of Light', they called it, before the war
translation: 战前，人们称它为‘光之城’
notes: 目的地短描述，保留无句号结构。
场景名。

source: A soggy mess of identity cards and mulched ration books, scavenged from the Dead of Kerisham beach.
translation: 身份证件与被泡烂的配给本混成一团湿漉漉的烂泥，都是从凯里沙姆海滩的死者身上搜来的。
notes: Dead 作为死者集合处理；Kerisham 暂沿前批译“凯里沙姆”。

source:
4-6 Weariness: "I could use a nap."

Current Weariness: [q=weariness]
translation:
4—6点疲惫：“我该打个盹。”

当前疲惫：[q=weariness]
notes: 保留段落、引语与查询变量。
Naenia 为挽歌，quittance 为解除／清偿；秘术物品名暂译“挽歌解契”。
Well-Groomed 作为梳洗状态译“仪容整洁”。

source: An effective cure for Weariness, but it always brings at least a little pain in its wake.
translation: 这是治疗疲惫的有效方法，但过后总会带来至少一点痛苦。
notes: 机制效果说明。

source:
The Corona-touched [[currency]] of the United States, buttery smooth beneath the fingertips, faintly luminous even in darkness. Much valued in the wilder hinterlands of Europe as a talisman of onteirological stability. The new five dollar bill is sometimes nailed above doors to invoke the protection the one whose likeness it bears - Barkley, who is both President and Incorporate.

Every other currency's value is expressed in terms of the dollar. Heaven bless America.
translation:
美利坚合众国受冕触及的[[currency]]，指腹下柔滑如黄油，即使在黑暗中也泛着微光。在欧洲那些更荒蛮的腹地，它被奉为维持本体秘理稳定的护符。新版五美元钞票有时会被钉在门上，祈求票面人物巴克利的庇护——他既是总统，也是法人团体。

其他所有货币的价值都以美元衡量。愿上天保佑美利坚。
notes: Corona 依术语表译“冕”；保留 currency 链接与段落；Incorporate 依补充术语表译“法人团体”；Onteirology 词根按总表译“本体秘理”。
状态显示名。

source: can wither as well as bewitch!
notes: 与本批逆序关键词句保持完全一致的术语。

source: Agio, the fee charged for exchanging currency. Wonderfully, it's derived from the italian aggio, meaning 'comfort' or 'ease'. The merchant is charging a fee for your comfort and ease. Whenever you pay in a non-native currency, a merchant will charge you agio - about fifteen per cent, but they'll round down.
translation: 贴水，即兑换货币时收取的费用。 妙的是，它源自意大利语aggio，意思是“舒适”或“方便”。商人收的，正是让你舒适方便的费用。 使用外地货币付款时，商人会收取贴水——约百分之十五，向下取整。
notes: 保留四组斜体标签、三段结构及首段尾随空格；Agio 采用金融术语“贴水”。
Sign 固定译“印记”。

source: You're set this item as active. Active Items work slightly differently in Travelling at Night from equipped items in most games. Mouse over the ACTIVE ITEMS header to learn more.
translation: 你已将此物品设为活动物品。《夜游漫记》中的活动物品，与大多数游戏里的装备物品略有不同。将鼠标悬停在“活动物品”标题上即可了解详情。
notes: 保留源文大小写不一致的富文本标签；作品名依术语表；ACTIVE ITEMS 与本批 UI 标签统一。

source: I've learnt that Aubière is accepting inducements from his residents to provide black market goods. He probably wouldn't want this to come out.
translation: 我得知奥比耶会收受住客好处，为他们提供黑市商品。他大概不希望此事曝光。
notes: 状态说明；inducements 按隐晦贿赂语境处理。

source: The amber town adrift on consolation's tides far from the rush of the world
translation: 琥珀色的小镇漂浮于慰藉之潮，远离世界的匆忙
notes: 目的地短描述；保留诗性与无句号结构。
地名。
变量标签；Medea 沿既有独立专名译法。

translation:
4—6点恐惧：“这一切似乎毫无意义。”

当前恐惧：[q=dread]
notes: 保留段落、引语与查询变量。
Edge 依术语表译“刃”；沿前批系统句式。

source: An intricate, beautiful pattern that's just brash enough to remain tasteful.
translation: 纹样繁复而美丽，恰好张扬到仍不失品味。
notes: 保留斜体强调及品味悖论。

source: [q=trace] Traces. From long experience, I know when I'm under Surveillance.
translation: [q=trace]点痕迹。凭多年经验，我知道自己何时正受监视。
notes: 保留查询变量；Surveillance 与同批状态标签统一译“监视”。

source: The new heart of Europe... not quite as broken as we might expect
translation: 欧洲的新心脏……并没有我们想象中那么破碎
notes: 目的地短描述；保留省略与无句号结构。
状态显示名。

source: The wound is visible; the pain is not.
translation: 伤口看得见；痛苦看不见。
notes: 保留对照、分号及源文尾随空格。
治疗类性相标签。
英国常见的印度渊源米饭料理。

source: Nina is absent from the circus. But she's here, somewhere. 'In the woods.'
translation: 妮娜不在马戏团里。但她就在这里，某个地方。‘在树林里。’
notes: 保留短句与引语中的不确定线索。
沿前批饮品译名。

source: 'Spencer Hobson: multiple entries Germany, US Zone of Occupation'. A single sheet of paper, enlivened with the flaming-sword stamp.
translation: “斯宾塞·霍布森：多次入境德国美占区。”一张纸，因烈焰之剑印章而平添几分生气。
notes: 保留官方记录的简略句式与 enlivened 的冷幽默；统一中文引号。
依术语表。

source: I've learnt what I needed from Dr A in his dream.
translation: 我已在奥比耶医生的梦里拿到所需情报。
notes: Dr A 按上下文展开。
品牌名暂音译。
意大利地名。
变量说明。
秘术物品名；保留肉身与火星的物质意象。
地名，暂按德语音译。
教程标题。
伟大之术相关机制标签；与 Enliven 的赋生语义呼应。

source: A horrible tangle of potential Worms or Worm-traces, modelled after the scars left in a host's soul.
translation: 一团可怖的纠结物，由潜在的蠕虫或蠕虫痕迹构成，仿照它们留在宿主灵魂上的伤疤塑成。
notes: Worms 作为设定存在译“蠕虫”；保留宿主灵魂伤痕意象。
货币名。
状态显示名。
Winter 依术语表译“冬”。

source: Give up this plan. No-op once the plan has concluded, so a won plan is never undone.
translation: 放弃此计划。计划结束后，此操作不会生效，因此已经胜出的计划不会被撤销。
notes: 玩家可见机制说明，按功能简洁翻译。
状态显示名。

source: In Europe now, the seasons often follow weather, not the other way around.
translation: 如今在欧洲，季节常常追随天气，而不是天气追随季节。
notes: 保留因果倒置的异常。

source: A hand-picked bunch, loosely tied with string.
translation: 亲手采下的一束，松松地用细绳扎着。
notes: 物品说明。
教程错误标题，指商人现金不足。
服装规则内部条件值，原样保留。
教程标题，保留口语。

source: Dr Aubière keeps close the secret of where to find Nina Lagasse. But in dreams, it's difficult to keep secrets.
translation: 奥比耶医生严守着妮娜·拉加斯下落的秘密。但在梦里，秘密很难守住。
notes: Nina Lagasse 依术语表；保留 keep secrets 的重复。

source: I've located a hidden space behind Aubière's office.
translation: 我找到了奥比耶办公室后面的暗间。
notes: 状态说明。
书籍状态名。

source: [q=Weariness] Weariness is enough to tip me over from Languor to Drowsiness.
translation: [q=Weariness]点疲惫足以让我从倦怠滑入困倦。
notes: 保留查询变量；Languor／Drowsiness 暂统一译“倦怠／困倦”。

source: Strathcoyne has access to black market cigars. Was Aubière involved in their provision?
translation: 斯特拉斯科因能弄到黑市雪茄。是奥比耶替他供应的吗？
notes: Aubière 按总表译“奥比耶”。

source:
'I knew a man who captured moths in a bell-jar. On nights like this, he would release them one by one to die in the candle.'

 Moth is the wild and perilous  [[Principle]] of chaos and yearning. Are its [[Hours]] [[Uncounted]], or only altered? Moth is not to be expected.
translation:
“我认识一个把飞蛾捕进钟形玻璃罩的人。每逢这样的夜晚，他会将它们逐只放出，让它们死在烛火里。”

 蛾是混沌与渴望那狂野而危险的[[Principle]]。它的[[Hours]]已成[[Uncounted]]，抑或只是改换了模样？别指望蛾循规蹈矩。
notes: Moth 依术语表译“蛾”；保留三处链接、段落及第二段前导空格；修正英语系表句法，末句保留 expected 的预期／预测双义。
秘术物品名；Unbroken 取无人踏破之雪意象。

source: Prick a one-dollar note ('bill', as the [[Incorporates]] would call it) in the correct pattern to awaken the Eye in the Pyramid. In lean times, use another sign of Authority. Needs a Lantern-aspected Memory, and a bill or a substitute.
translation: 按正确图样刺穿一张一美元纸币（[[Incorporates]]称之为‘钞票’），以唤醒金字塔中的眼睛。拮据时，也可使用其他权威标志。需要一份带灯性相的记忆，以及一张钞票或替代品。
notes: 保留链接；Lantern 依术语表译“灯”；Eye in the Pyramid 按美元图像直译。
姓名沿 chunk_008。

source: Nina agreed to introduce me to something that could tell me where to find the graves of the Hours... in exchange for a single unspecified future service.
translation: 妮娜答应把我介绍给某种能告知司辰墓地所在的东西……代价是日后替她做一件尚未说明的事。
notes: Hours 依术语表译“司辰”；保留 something 的非人含混。
Moth 依术语表译“蛾”。

source:
I'll need two things: an Influence with the Grail aspect, and something Sharp to shed my blood (a razor blade would do).


I can craft it at a Verdant Place - also, with Bosk 5, at a Shadowed Place; with Birdsong 5, at a Threshold; or with Preservation 5, at a Hearth.
translation:
我需要两样东西：一道带杯性相的影响，以及一件能让我放血的锋利之物（剃须刀片即可）。


我可以在葱郁之地制作它；丛林学达到 5 级时，也可以在暗影之地制作；鸟鸣学达到 5 级时，可以在门槛制作；保存术达到 5 级时，则可以在炉边制作。
notes: Grail／Bosk／Birdsong／Preservation 按术语作“杯／丛林学／鸟鸣学／保存术”；保留三处换行与末尾 LF；统一数值空格。

translation: 记忆：圣凯瑟琳节前夕，亚历山大港，1948年
notes: 回忆标题。
关系 UI 标签。

source: A little white ceramic jar from Aubière's box - the pyx, the reliquary, whatever it was.
translation: 奥比耶盒子里的一只白色小陶罐——圣体盒也好，圣物匣也好，不管它到底是什么。
notes: pyx／reliquary 按宗教器物译“圣体盒／圣物匣”，保留主角的不确定。
Forge 依术语表译“铸”。
状态显示名。
饮品状态名，沿前批菜单语境。
地名。

source: Separate; excise; banish. The Horned-Axe's purpose.
translation: 分离；切除；放逐。双角斧的职责。
notes: Horned-Axe 依术语表译“双角斧”；保留三项分号排比。
德语普通名词，指随身扁酒壶。

source: Lucent intellect, merciless revelation, aureate clarity. Lantern is the principle of the secret place sometimes called the House of the Sun, or the [[Mansus]], and of the light above it. It is [[Corona]] and [[Gleam]], now, the West and the East, and the eyes of its [[Hours]] are closed.
translation: 明澈的智识，无情的启示，金色的清明。灯是那处秘密所在——有时称为太阳的居屋，或[[Mansus]]——以及其上之光的准则。如今，它是西方的[[Corona]]与东方的[[Gleam]]；它的[[Hours]]已闭上双眼。
notes: Lantern／Principle／House of the Sun 依术语表；保留三个链接；Corona／Gleam 的东西方对应按语序明确。
状态显示名。
状态显示名。
沿 chunk_009 回忆标题译法。

source: The story is that Solomon Husher would use this rite when he wished to leave no footprints. Husher was not a man to fear the Dread this rite sometimes provokes.
translation: 据说，所罗门·赫舍不想留下脚印时，便会施行这项仪式。赫舍可不是会怕这仪式偶尔招来恐惧的人。
notes: Solomon Husher 暂按人名音译；保留 Dread 普通情绪与机制状态的重叠。

source: Everyone in Europe knows that the unimpeachable value of their [[currency]]. Even on the eastern side of the Iron Curtain, even legitimate businesses will quietly accept payment in Swiss francs. It is odd that the Ministries permit use of a gold-backed currency in their mutualist paradise. But there has been something opaque happening in Switzerland, ever since the Alps grew colder. One Swiss franc is worth about one dollar.
translation: 欧洲人人都知道这种[[currency]]价值可靠，无可置疑。即使在铁幕东侧，连正经商家也会悄悄收下瑞士法郎。 联盟竟会允许在他们的互助主义天堂使用金本位货币，的确奇怪。但自阿尔卑斯山愈发寒冷以来，瑞士便一直有些事，教人看不透。 一瑞士法郎约值一美元。
notes: 保留链接、大小写不一致的富文本标签与三段结构；Ministries 依补充术语表译“联盟”；保留 opaque 的金融／神秘双义。

source:
'Fire,' I read once, 'is the winter that warms and the spring that consumes.`

The Hour we called the Forge of Days is Uncounted now, but Forge is still the  [[Principle]] that transforms and destroys.
translation:
“火，”我曾读到，“是暖人的冬，是吞噬的春。”

我们称作白日铸炉的司辰如今已失数，但铸仍是转化与毁灭的[[Principle]]。
notes: Forge of Days／Forge／Hour 依术语表译“白日铸炉／铸／司辰”；保留链接、段落及尾随空格。 术语归位：Uncounted 谓语/定语形统一为"失数"（名词形"失数者"），不用释义性变体"不在数中"。

source:
4-6 Pain: Ow damnit ow.

Current Pain: [q=pain]
translation:
4—6点痛苦：疼，该死，好疼。

当前痛苦：[q=pain]
notes: 保留段落、查询变量与骤然口语化的痛呼。

source: 'Spencer Hobson: multiple entries Italian Republic, Free Territory of Trieste'. A single sheet of paper, enlivened with the flaming-sword stamp of Supreme Headquarters Allied Expeditionary Force.
translation: ‘斯宾塞·霍布森：多次入境意大利共和国、的里雅斯特自由区。’一张纸，因盟军远征军最高司令部的烈焰之剑印章而平添几分生气。
notes: 采用机构通行中译；保留 enlivened 的冷幽默。
物品名；manila 指马尼拉纸材质。

translation: 马克斯写给泽莉娅的信
notes: 物品名。
变量标签。
教程标题。
意大利即兴喜剧中列出演出情节的提纲，译“幕表”。

source: Philomèle asked me to convey her compliments to the bookseller Andrée, who sells other things than books.
translation: 菲洛梅勒托我向书商安德蕾问好；她卖的并不只有书。
notes: 保留 quieter business 的含蓄暗示。
与本批制作完成状态统一。

source:
Spencer was never really an adept - and the [[Worms]] took much of his ability from him - but he can prepare tools to achieve a variety of supernatural effects in dialogue. As his Unworldly [[Skills]] increase, he'll be able to create more powerful tools.

You need to be at at a crafting [[Venue]] to make anything - you're at one now - but you can look through Spencer's recipes whenever you like.
translation:
斯宾塞从来算不上真正的修习者——而且[[Worms]]夺走了他的许多能力——但他仍能准备工具，在对话中实现各种超自然效果。随着他的异世[[Skills]]提升，他将能制作更强大的工具。

你必须身处制作[[Venue]]才能制作物品——你现在就在一处——不过随时都可以查看斯宾塞的配方。
notes: 保留三个链接与段落；Unworldly 沿前批译“异世”；源文 at at 重复按正常中文整理。

translation: 看法——J.N. 西农布尔医生
notes: Sinombre 按总表译“西农布尔”；保留姓名缩写。

source: VISADO DE ENTRADA. The consul's signature adorns a stamp of vivid violet ink - yoke, arrows, eagle, and the Pillars of Hercules. Look close enough, and there's a tiny radiance at the top of each pillar, like a candle flame.
translation: VISADO DE ENTRADA。领事签名落在鲜艳紫墨的印章上——轭、箭、鹰，以及赫拉克勒斯之柱。凑近细看，每根柱顶都有一点微光，宛如烛焰。
notes: 西班牙语签证标题原样保留；保留印章政治符号与超自然微光。
秘术物品名。

source: Soon, all Europe will open to you, as long as you can obtain the right documents. But right now, there's only one place you need to go.
translation: 只要能拿到合适的证件，很快整个欧洲都会向你敞开。但眼下，你只需要去一个地方。
notes: 旅行教程，避免把 right 机械译作“正确”。

translation: 文森特认识的我是‘斯宾塞·霍布森’。
notes: 化名状态说明。

source: Skeleton-strewn, [[Gleam]]-gifted; but memories linger of the second capital of the Dual Monarchy
translation: 骸骨遍地，蒙[[Gleam]]赐福；但双元帝国第二首都的记忆仍在徘徊
notes: 保留链接、分号与无句号结构；Dual Monarchy 译“双元帝国”。
制作槽位标签，与配方说明统一。

source: I declined, once I'd heard more about it.
translation: 听过更多内情后，我拒绝了。
notes: 状态说明。

source: A welcome warmth. I'm no longer Chilly.
translation: 一阵可喜的暖意。我已经不再发冷。
notes: Chilly 暂译“发冷”。
UI 结果标签。

source: A token invested with heavenly power, in defiance of Corona's claims of solar seignorage. Used for Bright Arts crafting recipes.
translation: 一枚注入高天之力的信物，公然违逆冕所宣称的太阳铸币权。用于光之技艺制作配方。
notes: Corona 依术语表作“冕”；solar seignorage 保留太阳权力与铸币权双关；Bright Arts 按新增术语作“光之技艺”。

source:
1-3 Pain: Distracting discomfort.

Current Pain: [q=pain]. Penalties at 4+...
translation:
1—3 点痛苦：疼得让人分心。

当前痛苦：[q=pain]。4 点起会有不利影响……
notes: 保留段落与查询变量；机制说明直接化。

source: Only [q=Pain] Pain - I'm no longer suffering Agonies, just Injured.
translation: 只剩 [q=Pain] 点痛苦——剧痛退了，只是还有伤。
notes: 保留查询变量；Agonies／Injured 译“剧痛／受伤”。
秘术物品／配方名；Leathy 取皮革般材质之意。

source: Currencies in Travelling at Night are rounded up or down - merchants don't give change - so you'll generally overpay a little, but this is a big overpayment! Sometimes, in post-Wars Europe, that's just the breaks. But for generous overpayments, we always check that you're sure.
translation: 《夜游漫记》中的货币金额会向上或向下取整——商人不找零——所以通常会多付一点，但这次多付得太多了！在诸战之后的欧洲，有时也只能认倒霉。不过遇到如此慷慨的多付金额，我们总会确认你是否当真。
notes: 保留大小写不一致的富文本标签；作品名依术语表；保留 that's just the breaks 的无奈调侃。

source: Use a Winter Influence to subvert two Edge Influences into a Winter Memory.
translation: 用一份冬之影响，将两份刃之影响转化为一份冬之记忆。
notes: Winter／Edge 依术语表译“冬／刃”。

source: Crisp new Deutsche Mark - the [[currency]] printed under Incorporate aegis to succeed the tainted and inflated Reichsmark. Bane of the black market; seed of the Blockade; worth twice an ostmark, or about a third of a dollar.
translation: 崭新挺括的德国马克——在法人团体庇护下印制的[[currency]]，用以取代污损而滥发的帝国马克。黑市之祸；封锁之种；值两枚奥斯特马克，或约三分之一美元。
notes: 保留链接与分号；Incorporate 依补充术语表译“法人团体”；Reichsmark／ostmark 统一译“帝国马克／奥斯特马克”。
状态显示名。

source: VIZĂ DE INTRARE. The arms of the People's Republic of Romania: a tractor before three factory chimneys crowned with smudges of smoke. A Star rises behind the horizon - tinted with something silverier than the aniline violet of the stamp.
translation: VIZĂ DE INTRARE。罗马尼亚人民共和国国徽：三根工厂烟囱前，一台拖拉机隆隆开过；烟囱上顶着几抹模糊烟迹。一颗星从地平线后升起——泛着比印章上苯胺紫更银白的色泽。
notes: 罗马尼亚语签证标题原样保留；保留政治徽号中 Star 的异常银光。
品牌通行译名。
物品名，与本批物品说明统一。

source:
An alchemical preparation intended to poison, to cure, or to stimulate. It refreshes Heart and Grail aspects, and is necessary for some higher-level crafting recipes.

[Pharmakon can also be used in some actions to drug or to cure others, if you have the skills. Don't consume it if you plan to use it for that.]
translation:
一种可用于下毒、治疗或刺激的炼金制剂。它能恢复心与杯性相，也是部分高级制作配方的必需品。

[若具备相应技艺，法尔马孔还可用于某些行动，给他人下药或治疗他人。若打算这样使用，就不要服用。]
notes: Pharmakon 暂音译“法尔马孔”；Heart／Grail 依术语表；保留段落与方括号。

source: Suitable for a cold climate; but bulky, and uncomfortable in the heat. A socially neutral aspect.
translation: 适合寒冷气候；但十分臃肿，天热时很难受。社交效果中性。
notes: 服装机制说明。

source: [q=Fascination] Fascination is enough to tip me over from Chrysophoria to Chrysolagnia, where the world grows more golden. I rather like it.
translation: [q=Fascination]点迷狂足以让我从金荷症滑入嗜金症。此后，世界愈发金黄。我倒很喜欢。
notes: 保留查询变量；Chrysophoria／Chrysolagnia 统一译“金荷症／嗜金症”。
教程标题。

source: 'In the secrecy of the polling booth, Heaven sees you -  the Advisor doesn't.' The Eternal City has chosen Corona, not Gleam... for now.
translation: ‘在投票亭的隐秘中，上天看得见你——顾问看不见。’永恒之城选择了冕，而不是烁……暂时如此。
notes: Corona／Gleam 依术语表译“冕／烁”；Advisor 暂译“顾问”；保留宣传口号与 for now 的不安。
设定病名，与同批转变提示统一。

source: Down to [q=Fascination] Fascination. I'm no longer Chrysolagnic, just Chrysophoric. The world seems dingier.
translation: 迷狂降至[q=Fascination]点。我已不再患嗜金症，只剩金荷症。世界似乎也黯淡了些。
notes: 保留查询变量；两阶段病名与同批统一。
Edge 依术语表译“刃”。
状态显示名，与 bewitch“施魅”对应。
保留查询变量；Chrysolagnic 与“嗜金症”统一。
物品名。
波兰人名。
依术语表。
依术语表。

source: Notice your wallet at the bottom left - the merchant's paid you in their native currency.
translation: 留意左下角的钱包——商人已经用当地货币向你付款。
notes: 交易教程说明。

source: An order for warm winter clothing, made to measure. [The package will appear in your inventory after you travel to another city.]
translation: 一份量身订制的保暖冬装订单。[旅行到另一座城市后，包裹会出现在物品栏中。]
notes: 保留句内方括号教程结构。
关系 UI 标签；Torgue 暂沿相邻批次译名。

translation: 奇特、罕见或古老的物件。
notes: 性相说明。

source:
It may be time to panic very slightly. One of [[Dread]], [[Pain]] or [[Fascination]] has reached 7. If it reaches 10, the game will end, and not in a good way.

But the situation merits only very slight panic. You still have time. Avoid situations that might increase the Trouble in question; sleep, or use a curative Rite; and you'll be fine.
translation:
现在也许该稍微惊慌一下了。[[Dread]]、[[Pain]]或[[Fascination]]之一已经达到7点。若达到10点，游戏便会结束，而且不会是好结局。

不过，局势只值得稍微惊慌。你还有时间。避开可能增加对应麻烦的情况；睡一觉，或使用治疗仪式；一切都会好起来。
notes: 保留三处链接与段落；教程口吻直接，同时保留“稍微惊慌”的反复冷幽默。
votum 兼有誓愿与奉献物之意，秘术物品名暂译“愿契”。

source: Green scents recall rain. Stronger scents recall the ozone of storms.
translation: 青绿的气味令人想起雨。更浓烈的气味，则令人想起暴风雨中的臭氧。
notes: 保留两句强度递进。
Coronal 依 Corona“冕”处理；Indulgence 取宗教赦宥之意。

source: I added something to cheer them up, with something else to wither Philomèle.
translation: 我加了点让他们高兴的东西，又掺了点能让菲洛梅勒凋萎的东西。
notes: wither 与机制术语“凋萎”统一。
Rose 依术语表译“引”。
Pilgrim 按总表译“朝圣者”；ostrakon 指刻写文字的古希腊陶片。

source:
On nights of the new moon, sometimes I found myself back at the Ecdysis Club...

Recall <link="mypaststkallisteseve">My Past: St Kalliste's Eve, London, 1923</link>
translation:
有时，在新月之夜，我会发现自己又回到了蜕衣俱乐部……

回忆<link="mypaststkallisteseve">我的过往：圣卡利斯特节前夕，伦敦，1923年</link>
notes: Ecdysis Club 与回忆标题沿 chunk_009／010；保留段落及 link 标签。
Forge 依术语表译“铸”；沿前批系统句式。

source:
The official [[Ministries]] currency - more than that, the currency of the Great Exchange, the mutual bank guaranteed by Stars themselves. Utterly reliable incarnation of Icarian-Proudhonist mutualism; onteiriologically perfect reflection of the value of labour; a means of exchange guaranteed not by gold or by silver, but by the fate-synthesis of the shining fellow-travellers from outside the sky. Universally accepted in the Soviet sphere, utterly forbidden in the West.

One dollar will get you four doli, if you can find someone to make the exchange.
translation:
[[Ministries]]的官方货币——更不止于此：它是大交换所的货币，而大交换所是一家由群星亲自担保的互助银行。它是伊加利亚—蒲鲁东式互助主义绝对可靠的化身，在本体秘理层面完美反映劳动价值；为它背书的不是金银，而是天外那些闪耀同志对命运的综合。苏联势力范围内无处不收，西方则严禁持有。

只要找得到肯换的人，一美元能换四多利。
notes: 保留 Ministries 链接与段落；Icarian 依补充术语译“伊加利亚”；Onteirology 词根按总表译“本体秘理”；doli 为 dolya 复数，译“多利”。

source: The only town of any size in Graustark; the seat of the von Nagelsburgs since the 1500s
translation: 格劳斯塔克唯一称得上规模的城镇；自16世纪以来便是冯·纳格尔斯堡家族的治所
notes: Graustark／von Nagelsburg 暂按虚构国名与家族名音译；保留无句号结构。
开发／展示标签。
Bounds 依术语表译“边境”。

source: I've been catching up with Vincent Chraibi.
translation: 我一直在和文森特·什拉伊比叙旧。
notes: Vincent Chraibi 沿 chunk_006 译名。
变量说明；保留两种运动方式的简短并列。
保留对“All that glitters”谚语的改写。
与本批已读状态统一。
源文为未拆分内部式显示名，按可见状态含义翻译。
教程标题。
状态标签。

source: A deadening chill; an expectation of silence; the apprehension of frost.
translation: 一股令人麻木的寒意；对寂静的等待；霜冻将至的忧惧。
notes: 保留三段分号排比与 apprehension 的预感／惧怕双义。
Ministries 依补充术语表译“联盟”。
变量标签。

source: The devastated city where the New King fell in battle - and its coastal lifeline
translation: 新王战死的残破之城——以及维系它的海路
notes: 目的地短描述；保留无句号结构。

source: Ignites on anything, burns with a clear and beautiful white flame. They don't make these any more, because the manufacturing process made the match-girls' jaws rot, then glow, then collapse. Except in the Vatican, for certain essential rights; and there, we are assured, the matches are produced so safely and carefully that phossy jaw is entirely unknown.
translation: 擦在任何东西上都能点燃，烧出清澈而美丽的白焰。如今已不再生产，因为制造过程会让火柴女工的下颌先腐烂，再发光，最终塌陷。梵蒂冈除外——为了某些必要仪式；我们得到保证，那里的火柴生产安全而谨慎，磷颌病闻所未闻。
notes: phossy jaw 译“磷颌病”；源文 essential rights 疑为 rites，结合梵蒂冈火柴用途按“必要仪式”处理。
状态／物品名。

source: To move, click on the ground. (Click tutorial messages to dismiss them.)
translation: 点击地面即可移动。 （点击教程消息可将其关闭。）
notes: 保留段落与斜体标签；操作教程保持直接。

source: At [q=Dread] Dread, my Unease has dissipated.
translation: 恐惧降至[q=Dread]点时，我的不安已经消散。
notes: 保留查询变量；Unease 与同批状态标签统一。

source:
Failure has its consolations and its consequences.

Consolations: Spencer gains more Experiences from Failure than from Success.

Consequences: When Spencer fails, he gains a Trouble.
translation:
失败有慰藉，也有后果。

慰藉：失败时，斯宾塞获得的经历比成功时更多。

后果：失败时，斯宾塞会惹上一项麻烦。
notes: 保留三段结构与 Consolations／Consequences 对照。
治疗类性相标签。

source:
7-9 Dread: "I can't."

Current Dread: [q=dread]

[BE VERY CAREFUL. At 10 or more Dread, the game may end.]
translation:
7—9 点恐惧：“我做不到。”

当前恐惧：[q=dread]

[务必万分小心。恐惧达到 10 点或以上时，游戏可能结束。]
notes: 保留查询变量、三段结构与方括号警告；统一数值空格。
Thunderskin 依术语表译“轰雷之皮”。

source: Nina's trail leads to the Sanitarium Aujourd'hui, just outside Antibes.
translation: 妮娜的踪迹通往昂蒂布城外不远的‘今日’疗养院。
notes: Sanitarium Aujourd'hui 沿前批译“‘今日’疗养院”。
状态标签。
变量标签。
物品名。
状态显示名。

source: Vincent's asked me to do 'reconnaissance' for the Chaima situation
translation: 文森特要我为夏伊玛那边的状况做一次‘侦察’。
notes: Chaima 与相邻批次统一作“夏伊玛”；保留 reconnaissance 引号中的夸张意味。

source: I've helped Father Jaume open the eyes of St Reparata.
translation: 我已帮海梅神父睁开圣雷帕拉塔的双眼。
notes: Father Jaume 按总表译“海梅神父”。
场景名。
地名，沿前批。
物品说明；保留简短神秘感。

source:
We all of us went stamping out from the cold rooms and the great pool of Bart's, into the meat markets where we saw again the things that are decently hidden beneath the skin...

Recall <link="mypaststtheophrastuseve">My Past: St Theophrastus' Eve, Smithfield, 1927</link>
translation:
我们所有人都跺着脚，从巴兹医院冰冷的房间和那座大水池走出来，走进肉市；在那里，我们再次看见那些被体面地藏在皮肤下面的东西……

回忆<link="mypaststtheophrastuseve">我的过往：圣泰奥弗拉斯托斯前夜，史密斯菲尔德，1927年</link>
notes: 正文沿 chunk_009，回忆标题沿前批专名；保留段落与 link 标签。

source:
7-9 Weariness: "I can hardly keep my eyes open..."

Current Weariness: [q=weariness]

[At 10 Weariness, Spencer will collapse, losing 3 Weariness but gaining 3 Pain.]
translation:
7—9点疲惫：“我的眼睛快睁不开了……”

当前疲惫：[q=weariness]

[疲惫达到10点时，斯宾塞会倒下，失去3点疲惫，但获得3点痛苦。]
notes: 保留查询变量、三段结构与方括号警告；数值严格按本条源文。
教程标题。

source: Shady shelter from the sun. I'm no longer Perspiring.
translation: 荫凉处遮住了太阳。我已经不再出汗。
notes: Perspiring 与同批状态提示统一。

source: She travels with a circus named 'Rosa Mundi.' They were due to perform in Mimata, among the mountains and gorges of Lozère.
translation: 她随一支名叫“罗莎·蒙迪”的马戏团旅行。他们原定在洛泽尔群山与峡谷间的米马塔演出。
notes: Rosa Mundi 沿用同批译名；地名按法语音译；统一中文引号。
内部状态显示名，保留技术字符串。

source:
A SPINE-CHILLING tale of a RENEGADE PRIEST whose KNIFE IS THIRSTY FOR INNOCENT BLOOD.

I wrote this under the name 'Meredith Lux', but here is it under the name 'Spencer Hobson'. Spine-chilling is right. It's painful even to look at the cover. But at least as long as I have it, there's one fewer copy in circulation.
translation:
一则毛骨悚然的故事，讲述一名叛教神父；他的刀渴求无辜者的鲜血。

我用‘梅雷迪思·勒克斯’这个名字写了它，但这一本署名‘斯宾塞·霍布森’。说它毛骨悚然倒没错。光看封面都让人痛苦。不过，只要它在我手里，市面上就少流通一本。
notes: 以夸张中文措辞承接封面全大写的廉价惊悚小说语气；保留双段结构。

source: Ravaged by the Enemy, smashed by the Allies, scoured by the trials of collaborators
translation: 遭敌人蹂躏，被盟军轰碎，又经通敌者审判洗刷
notes: 目的地碎片式描述，不补句号。
沿用项目既定货币译名。
Chaima 与相邻批次统一作“夏伊玛”。
Vertumnal 取四时轮转之意；Mommet 与同批统一作“人偶”。
服装性相标签，强调时髦而不拘常规。

source: Unbutton my coat. I'm no longer Snug.
translation: 解开外套纽扣。我已不再裹得严实。
notes: Snug 为穿着保暖状态。
状态标题。

source:
A betraying clue.

As Traces accumulate, as my name gets around, I'm more likely to be recognised. Sometimes this might be good. I won't count on it being good.

[Spencer can gain Traces from truthfully sharing personal information, interacting with the authorities, or simply staying in one place too long. Sleeping in the same place for one night is safe - every night after that adds a Trace. Traveling to a new city removes Traces, as long as you don't keep travelling the same route.]
translation:
一条会出卖我的线索。

痕迹越多，我的名字传得越广，就越容易被人认出来。有时这会带来好处。可我不打算指望。

[斯宾塞如实透露个人信息、与当局打交道，或只是在同一地点待得太久，都会增加痕迹。在同一地点睡一晚是安全的——此后每多睡一晚，就多一道痕迹。换一座城市能减少痕迹，只要你不总走同一路线。]
notes: Traces 统一作“痕迹”；保留三段结构与方括号教程。
角色附肢轴名。
物品名。
以酒色还原 Grenadine Claret 的综合色调。
变量标签，保留技术字符串。
内部状态显示名。

source:
The wind reaches right through my thin clothing to lay itself against my skin.

[Change to a warmer Outfit - or stay inside.]
translation:
风穿透单薄衣料，直接贴上我的皮肤。

[换上更保暖的服装——或者留在室内。]
notes: 保留双段结构与方括号提示。

source:
Choices prowled by possibility; a sense of horizons.

[Rose influences are the only influences that don't fade on Travel.]
translation:
诸般选择间，可能性四处游猎；地平线隐约在望。

[只有引之影响不会因旅行而消退。]
notes: Rose 依术语表作“引”；保留双段结构与方括号提示。
配方与物品共用标题。

source:
One summer Saturday, in my first year as parish priest...

Recall <link="mypaststmelanctheseve">My Past: St Melancthe's Eve, Brancrug, 1919</link>
translation:
我担任本堂神父的第一年，有一个夏日的星期六……

回忆<link="mypaststmelanctheseve">我的过往：圣梅兰克忒前夜，布兰库格，1919年</link>
notes: 保留 link 标签及两段结构；人名、地名依同批音译。
开发用音乐状态标签。
制作状态标题。
包裹内容名沿用同批译名。

source: Apparently Strathcoyne's semi-independent appendage has been nicknamed 'Annabelle'. Strathcoyne really doesn't like that.
translation: 显然，斯特拉斯科因那条半独立的附肢得了个绰号：‘安娜贝尔’。斯特拉斯科因非常不喜欢这个名字。
notes: 保留冷面幽默。

source: New concrete, old bones, thin rations, thinner refugees
translation: 新混凝土，旧骸骨；口粮单薄，难民更加瘦弱
notes: 目的地碎片式描述，保留递进，不补句号。

source: A Wakeful Eye can [[Hallow]] or [[Unveil]] - unlocking conversation choices that require those Aspects. It'll also give a bonus to Skills when placed in an Active slot. Be careful - whatever you do with it, it's a one-use item.
translation: 醒觉之眼可以[[Hallow]]或[[Unveil]]——用来解锁需要这些性相的对话选项。放入活动槽位时，它也会为技艺提供加成。小心：无论拿它做什么，都只能用一次。
notes: 原样保留两个机制链接；Skill 按术语表统一为“技艺”。

source: The world seems closer and clearer again. I'm no longer Despairing.
translation: 世界又变得亲近而清晰。我不再绝望。
notes: Despairing 与同批条件译名“绝望”统一。

source:
A token of the old order of Heaven - or of [[Corona]], which claims to be its inheritor.  An Incorporate dollar is the easiest option, but there are ways to craft a token in the absence of greenbacks.

[Since the Wars, the currency of Corona is used for the Bright Arts - but you can create an Eye of Authority as a substitute.]
translation:
旧日高天秩序的一枚信物——或者说，是自称其继承者的[[Corona]]之信物。  法人团体美元是最容易取得的选择，但没有美钞时，也有办法制作这样的信物。

[诸战以来，冕的货币被用于光之技艺——但你可以制作权威之眼作为替代。]
notes: Incorporate、Bright Arts 按新增术语作“法人团体”“光之技艺”；保留链接、双空格、分段和方括号。
保留查询变量；Chrysolagnic 与同批状态“嗜金症”统一。

source: This is a Rite. it works the same way as any other Recipe, but it'll reduce [[Troubles]] and provide a small random benefit. Some Rites are less safe and may increase other [[Troubles]]. The description will warn you.
translation: 这是一项仪式。用法与其他配方相同，但会减少[[Troubles]]，并随机带来一点好处。有些仪式不太安全，可能增加别的[[Troubles]]。说明里会写明。
notes: 原样保留两处 Troubles 机制链接。
性相标签。

source: The Ministries have taken an interest in me.
notes: Ministries 按新增术语作“联盟”。

source: Stylish, unconventional, flashy. Likely to provoke a positive or negative reaction in most characters.
translation: 时髦、不落俗套、惹眼。大多数人物不是喜欢，就是讨厌。
notes: 服装性相说明。
Winter 按准则作“冬”。
Anagnorisis 取戏剧中的真相识认、顿悟义，暂作“识悟”。

source: Conventional, conservative, unremarkable. A safe option, although more unconventional souls will be put off.
translation: 传统、保守、毫不起眼。是个安全选择，不过更不拘常规的灵魂会感到厌烦。
notes: 服装性相说明。
Gleam 依性相术语作“烁”。
教程标题。
Aubière 按总表译“奥比耶”。
配方与物品共用标题；Glass 暂按材质物品处理。
Mithraeum 为密特拉教祭祀场所。
影响物品短说明。

source: ''Wit's forge and fire-blast, meaning's press and screw.' - Coleridge, 'On Donne's Poetry'
translation: “才智之锻炉与烈焰，意义之压机与螺杆。”——柯勒律治，《论多恩的诗》
notes: 原文开头双单引号疑为排印错误；按引文语义翻译，作者与篇名规范化。
条件资源名。

source: I blighted Philomèle, completing Zèlia's revenge. I should return to the park and collect my payment.
translation: 我已经凋萎菲洛梅勒，完成了泽莉娅的复仇。该回公园领取报酬了。
notes: blighted 与机制动作 Wither 的“凋萎”统一。
经历资源分组标题。
Mahaggony 视为专名，按相邻批次统一作“马哈戈尼”。

source: [q=Weariness] Weariness is enough to make me Languorous.
notes: 保留查询变量；Languorous 与同批条件“倦怠”统一。

source:
I agreed to consider Zèlia's request. This means I could fulfil it, ignore it, or try to deceive her.

[Create a Wither item with an Unworldly Art, and find an opportunity to taint Philomèle's food or drink. Or speak with Philomèle, then return to Zèlia and pretend you did as she asked. Or just move on.]
translation:
我答应考虑泽莉娅的请求。可以照办，可以不理，也可以骗她。

[用一项异世技艺制作带有凋萎功效的物品，再找机会在菲洛梅勒的食物或饮料里动手脚。也可以只同她谈谈，随后回去见泽莉娅，假装已经照办。又或者，干脆继续上路。]
notes: Wither 作“凋萎”，Unworldly Art 作“异世技艺”；保留双段结构与方括号。

source: A touchstone and talisman, worn as a good-luck piece until its owner became too closely acquainted with a howitzer shell at Remagen. The amulet survived the experience, so perhaps it assures its own good luck.
translation: 一枚试金石兼护符，原主人一直把它当作幸运物佩戴，直到在雷马根与一发榴弹炮炮弹过分亲密地相识。护符从那次经历中幸存下来，所以它保佑的或许是自己的好运。
notes: 保留原文对战死与护符幸存的冷面黑色幽默。
